Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Abstract Black and White Print of Tree Line in Black Frame, 24" x 16"
Colors: Black
Materials: canvas
This abstract depiction of a silhouette of trees brings an edgy look along with a touch of nature to your room. Stark black trees are printed against a white background for a modern look ideal for an urban-style setting. A modern take on a nature theme Hand-stretched canvas on wood, encased in black floater frame 26" x 18" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
